title: Premium Australian Products
For Growing Asian Markets
description: APPP supplies selected Australian health supplements and dairy products to business customers in Mainland China.
Through product sourcing, export coordination, order fulfilment and market development support, we help international businesses access quality Australian products and reliable supply solutions.

about.title: A Sydney-based sourcing and export partner
description: Australia Premium Products Platform Pty Ltd (APPP) is a Sydney-based B2B product sourcing and export company.

We work with established Australian suppliers and manufacturing partners to supply selected health supplements, full cream milk powder, skim milk powder and private label product solutions to international business customers.

Mainland China is one of our established export markets. We are continuing to develop new customers, distribution relationships and sales channels within China, including emerging opportunities in Hainan.

items.title: Serving Mainland China
description: APPP currently supplies selected Australian health supplements and dairy products to customers in Mainland China through wholesale, export and order fulfilment arrangements.

Different products and sales channels may have different import, registration, labelling and platform requirements. Product availability is assessed individually according to the product, customer and intended sales channel.

items.title: Expanding Into Hainan
description: APPP is currently engaging with potential business partners and reviewing product-entry and retail-channel opportunities in Hainan.
This work includes understanding applicable import access, product documentation and platform listing requirements.
Any future supply or product launch in Hainan will be subject to the applicable regulatory requirements, commercial arrangements and formal approvals.
